scope: v2 algorithm optimization with a newly untouched image-level audit set

audit_selection.method: numpy.default_rng(seed).choice over lexicographically sorted unused official-test filenames, without replacement; sorted chosen names for processing

dev.purpose: All algorithm design, model choices, thresholds and suppression calibration. References and truth may be used only by evaluation/calibration code.

regression.purpose: Previously inspected v1 official-test images. Regression diagnostic only; no longer called unseen or independent test.

audit_test.purpose: Run only after v2 source and operating points are frozen on dev. No parameter/model changes based on these outcomes.

data_contract.preprocessing: RGB short-side Lanczos resize; centered square crop; float luminance 0.2125R+0.7154G+0.0721B; no contrast normalization
data_contract.truth_firewall: Denoiser gets observed image and frozen config only. All reference images, envelopes, true frequencies and masks remain evaluation-only.

primary_questions.question: Does selecting a scale help compared with forced128 while preserving all cross-scale evidence?
primary_questions.metric: Per-image mean PSNR difference, contaminated-region MSE; bootstrap by image not individual variants.

primary_questions.question: At a matched amount of removal, is the clean-region damage smaller?
primary_questions.metric: Contaminated MSE versus clean-region MSE Pareto curves over a development-frozen strength grid; match only common positive-removal interval; report coverage and exclusions.

primary_questions.question: Do local amplitude and quadratic phase models improve the intended nonstationarity without overfitting clean textures?
primary_questions.metric: paired PSNR/MSE and clean control MAE; runtime, fail rate, phase/amplitude maps, model selection counts.

required_comparisons: v2 complete method with operating point chosen solely on dev
v2 forced128 preserving candidates, cross-scale and guard evidence
v2 conservative decision disabled while preserving residual/model estimates
v2 quadratic phase disabled while preserving amplitude model and decision
v2 amplitude variation disabled while preserving phase model and decision

global adaptive and ARPENOS source-guided port on the five-method primary audit; existing v1 global-fixed and native fixed128 results remain contextual regression references, not new60-audit estimates
v2 local texture-complexity risk disabled alone, retaining candidate residuals and global guard
v2 peak-only decision: retain global ambiguity guard and residual estimates, disable neighbor/cross-scale scoring and local texture risk
v2 candidate energy eligibility gate disabled alone, retaining all other decisions
freeze_before_audit: v2 source SHA256, configuration SHA256, calibration record and protocol SHA256
all method names and ablation semantics, including whether residual/guard prepare time is charged
operating-point grid and exact dev objective including clean-damage penalty
strength sweep values and IDs: audit aggregate can use all60; any subset must be fixed by ID before metrics
example IDs selected by stored order; worst-case gallery deliberately selected by error and labeled as such
validation_gates: 30 dev / 60 regression / 60 audit IDs are pairwise disjoint, and source official splits are respected
all variants of one image stay in the same split; amplitude variants share geometry, frequency and phase
every planned method has one result or an explicit exception row for each sample, with Cartesian-key completeness
finite bounded output, PSNR/SSIM data_range=1, no per-image contrast stretching, common feasible projection
clean-region errors are blank when region is absent; program exceptions and quality regressions are separate
conjugate frequency equivalence, positive overlap weight sum, odd rectangular boundaries, zero-strength identity
ambiguous identical-pixel dual interpretations and multi-periodic/chirped legitimate texture failures are retained

acceptance_interpretation.implementation: All explicit algorithm switches and diagnostics work and pass the numerical invariants.
acceptance_interpretation.effectiveness: An optimization is supported only where the frozen audit difference and clean-damage/removal trade-off support it. Zero or negative contributions must be reported. Implementation alone is not evidence of improvement.
acceptance_interpretation.texture_boundary: A guard may abstain on globally explainable periodic inputs, including equivalent flat-field-plus-interference interpretations; it must not claim unique separation.

frozen_evaluation_budget.status: specified before evaluating new audit images; algorithm/configuration freeze recorded separately

controlled_ablation.selection: first20 in stored manifest order, fixed before algorithm evaluation
controlled_ablation.full_reference: v2_full at identical samples from primary_audit
variants_to_test: force128 with cross-scale and guard evidence preserved
disable conservative decision with same selected residuals
disable quadratic phase preserving amplitude model and decision
disable amplitude variation preserving phase model and decision
controlled_ablation.reporting: Report every planned switch separately. If a proposed model is not implemented or rejected on dev, record that fact and omit its audit variant explicitly; do not silently relabel overlapping variants.
controlled_ablation.combined_disable_note: Quadratic phase and amplitude variation are each disabled independently. Simultaneously disabling both is not included in this fixed budget, so their interaction is not separately identified.

matched_removal.selection: first10 in stored manifest order, fixed before algorithm evaluation
matched_removal.comparison: v2 conservative versus same v2 residual estimates with decision disabled
matched_removal.strength_grid: must be fixed from development before audit; no new operating point selected from audit curves
matched_removal.matching: Pareto envelope and finite-grid linear interpolation only inside overlapping positive-removal interval; report per-image coverage and pooled mean curves separately
warnings: Ten images is a diagnostic subset, not full-audit evidence.
Images with no positive removal common interval must be counted, not silently discarded.
Averaging curves can hide cases with no benefit; report individual coverage.

texture_and_ambiguity_suite.source: same preexisting deterministic supplemental texture definitions plus any development-defined suite frozen before audit
texture_and_ambiguity_suite.purpose: stress test and ambiguity demonstration, not independent natural-image evidence

decision_ablation.selection: same predetermined first20 audit IDs as residual/scale ablation

methods.v2_without_texture_risk: Only local structural-complexity risk disabled; global guard, candidate estimates and other evidence retained
methods.v2_peak_only: Only peak evidence for local score; global ambiguity guard and residual estimates retained; neighbor/cross-scale scoring and local texture risk disabled
methods.v2_without_candidate_gate: Only candidate energy eligibility gate disabled; residual/model/scales and other guard evidence retained

decision_ablation.reuse: Reuse identical candidate residual estimates across these decisions so the comparison concerns decision logic rather than a changed fitted residual.

psnr_gain_is_not_sufficient: Compare new v2 against v1 on the same samples and report both per-image PSNR gain and clean-region MSE/MAE.
All60 clean controls must report mean, median,95th percentile and maximum modification MAE, and count of nontrivially modified images.
Separate program exceptions from quality regressions; show condition-level regression proportions and worst examples.
Any lower clean damage achieved solely by near-zero removal is excluded from protection claims via matched-removal curves.
Global/chirp/orientation currently have no true clean region, so texture protection cannot be claimed from their absent region metrics.
additional_quality_reporting.primary_decision: Whether practical gains are worth added damage should be stated as a measured trade-off. No universal dominance claim if v2 improves noise removal but increases clean/legitimate-texture damage.
additional_quality_reporting.confidence: Scores are heuristic reliability values, not calibrated probabilities.
additional_quality_reporting.uncertainty: Bootstrap original-image units. Average the three amplitude variants within an image before resampling; do not treat720 variants as independent subjects.
